CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Oneirodex** is a self-hosted game library for a household. Scan folders of DRM-free games and ROMs, identify them with game metadata, and browse the catalog with family members.
This repository contains the Oneirodex Docker template for Unraid Community Applications. It installs the single-container image with PostgreSQL embedded. Keep Appdata on cache or SSD storage, mount the Games share read-only, and complete the setup wizard in the WebUI.
Project and source: https://github.com/cephyrixzyth/Oneirodex Setup guide: https://github.com/cephyrixzyth/Oneirodex/blob/main/docs/runbooks/unraid-community-apps.md Issues: https://github.com/cephyrixzyth/Oneirodex/issues
Oneirodex is for software you are authorized to share. It ships no BIOS or firmware.
